newsitem.title: SPAIN: Venezuela's Viasa airline could make $14mln - Iberia.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Viasa airline could make $14mln - Iberia.

text.p: Viasa, the Venezuelan airline managed by Iberia, could make a profit of $14 million next year if the restructuring plan agreed by shareholders on Wednesday is enacted, Iberia said in a statement.
This compares with a loss of around $18 million this year and substantial losses every year since privatisation in 1991.

The Spanish airline, which owns 45 percent of Viasa, won approval from the other shareholders for its restructuring plan for Viasa which involves cutting 380 out of 2,200 jobs, freezing pay and suspending unprofitable routes.
Fondo de Inversiones de Venezuela, with a 40 percent stake, has agreed to fund the job cuts with $18 million and provide a further $4 million for operational improvements, Iberia said.
Iberia for its part has agreed to pardon some of Viasa's debt and reduce interest payments on the rest.
The plan now has to be accepted by Viasa's workers before January 15. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
